sentences.text:
Hear d I.A.No.14058/2024, which is an application for taking the documents on record is taken up,
considered and allowed for the reasons mentioned therein and the documents filed by the applicant is taken on record.

This is fifth application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No. 238 of 2020 registered at Police Station Myana, District Guna (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 201 of IPC.

His last bail application was dismissed as withdrawn in M.Cr.C. No. 25324 of 2023 vide order dated 28.02.2024.
2.

Learned counsel for the applicant argued that after withdrawal of last bail application statements of bank officials i.e. Shiv Kumar Raghuwanshi/PW/4, Rahul Raghuwanshi/PW/5 as well as other prosecution witnesses i.e. Vishnu Namdev/(PW/6), Vinod Singh Raghuwanshi/(PW/7), Balveer Raghuwanshi/(PW/8), Babu Singh Raghuwanshi/(PW/9) and Mahendra Raghuwanshi/(PW/10)
have been recorded, however, they have not supported the case of prosecution and turned hostile.
It is further argued that under these 2 MCRC-20491-2024 circumstances, when the material prosecution witnesses have not supported the case of prosecution, case of prosecution becomes doubtful.
Further submission is that statement of Rahul Raghuwanshi/(PW/5) in his cross examination contradicts the prosecution story.

He has specifically mentioned that in the bank form,
the mobile number of complainant-Mittan was recorded and the message was also sent in registered mobile number.
Under these circumstances, all the material prosecution witnesses have been examined as well as applicant is in custody for about four years, he is entitled to grant the benefit of bail.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Ashoknagar (M.P.) and there i s n o possibility

sentences.text: On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
3. Per contra, learned counsel for the State has vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

4. Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.
5.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
7. Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
8. E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
9. Certified copy as per rules.
